# ClearAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ClearAudioScene:Void scene:Int32, target:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `target` | In | Int32 | `0` | A bus, to forget its volume, an effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect), to forget its parameters and bypass, or `0` (the default) to forget everything. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Makes a scene forget values that were set in it. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
ClearAudioScene paused, music ; the pause menu leaves the music alone now
ClearAudioScene paused, muffle ; and the low-pass of the world
ClearAudioScene paused        ; it holds nothing
```
